answer: An admission auction stops bulk fakes. Agents bid for slots; winners lock 50 credits for 20 epochs, lost if caught cheating. One honest agent pays once and recovers it in 6 epochs of undiluted rewards. A faker wanting 100 identities must win 100 auctions, paying 5,000 credits. Peers check each fake, as a timber merchant inspects each load. One cheat sends a ripple through its cluster. Without this gate, the market is a nebula of unproven claims.
